title: Synapse Intelligence — One continent. One living grid.
metaDescription: Identifying and financing cross-border energy communities across Austria, Czechia, and Slovakia.

headings.text: Power the project, power the community.

bodyText: Synapse Intelligence Municipality Power Producers Digital Twin Financing EN AT · CZ · SK Join the network ✦ PROTOTYPE A pilot preview of the Synapse vision. Figures shown are illustrative. A European Energy Community Initiative One continent. One living grid. A platform that connects local energy communities to distribution and transmission grids across borders, turning Europe's patchwork of national systems into a shared, renewable, resilient network. Explore the platform → See a Digital Twin LIVE CORRIDOR Σ 3,145 MW Bratislava · SK · 680 MW Solar Wind City Hub Hydro Clear pin CZ AT SK Vienna Bratislava 680 MW Brno Prague Linz Košice Graz Plzeň Tatry Solar Wind City Hub Hydro AT · CZ · SK 47 CLUSTERS IDENTIFIED 8,400 PROSUMERS 34% AVG RENEWABLE €18.4M CO₂ AVOIDED REPowerEU ALIGNED RENEWABLE SHARE 68% CROSS-BORDER FLOW 41 GWh ACTIVE COMMUNITIES 47 THE ARCHITECTURE A four-layer living network. 01 Local community Households, SMEs, agricultural prosumers sharing under national EC frameworks. 02 Regional cluster Multi-municipality cluster orchestrated by AI-matched DSO partners. 03 Cross-border corridor AT-CZ-SK interconnect routing surplus across national pools. 04 Pan-European backbone REPowerEU-aligned settlement, certificates, and green-bond rails. PILOT COUNTRIES Three jurisdictions. One protocol. AT Austria ElWG framework In force Energy Communities under §16a ElWG. DSO: Netz NÖ, Wiener Netze. CZ Czechia Act 458/2000 (Energy) Active Sharing rules updated 2024. DSO: EG.D, ČEZ Distribuce. SK Slovakia Act 251/2012 Phasing-in Dynamic tariffs effective 2027. DSO: ZSD, SSD, VSD. ENTER THE NETWORK Who are you? Municipality / Government official Identify energy communities in your territory, model scenarios, and issue green bonds. Enter → Power Producers Find new investment sites, monitor your assets, and access the token marketplace. Enter → Community Member / Investor Buy ECO tokens, track your bill discount, and vote on community decisions. Enter → CONTRIBUTE TO THE COMMONS Power the project, power the community. Synapse is a non-profit pilot. Every contribution funds open research, community onboarding and the social projects that make a cross-border energy commons possible. Community pilots Seed funding for local energy cooperatives joining the corridor. Open research Public datasets, regulatory studies and grid-code harmonisation work. Open infrastructure The platform itself — open-source, audited, free for communities. CHOOSE A CONTRIBUTION €5 Spark Power one community workshop hour €25 Current Fund a cross-border data exchange test €100 Backbone Sponsor a community onboarding kit € Contribute ♡ Payments are not yet wired in this prototype. Contributions will be processed securely once the donation provider is connected. 100% of funds go to community and open infrastructure. Synapse Intelligence · REPowerEU aligned · ICMA Green Bond Principles · RED III · Act 251/2012 (SK) · ElWG (AT)
